pages.title: Exotic Solder
pages.text: Solder forged in stellar plasma. Exotic matter gives it negative energy density, quark-gluon plasma gives it strength, and it joins components that ordinary solder would vaporise. It flows like liquid starlight.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The attoscale components needed something stronger than superconducting solder. Forging it with an Exotic Matter Crystal and quark-gluon plasma in the Stellar Plasma Crucible gave me a solder with exotic properties.

Made in $(item)Stellar Plasma Crucible$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Capacitor, Attoscale Inductor, Attoscale Transistor, Burst Observatory, Causal Solder, Cosmic Circuit Board, Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block, Dimensional Residue and more.
